work.projectDescription:
Cyber Bounty Hunter

DATA

Augmented reality
Cyberpunk 
HSC - Araska esk company/Mega Corpo
Evil Synths
Evil cyborgs
Symbiotes 
Space is possible in this world - What is available?
Centered city - What name is it? 

3D world- Highlighted portion is our Game for the assignment

How does the player get to the bountys? Gameplay Loop Routes
- Route 1: Info Brokers (Expensive/Straight to the point/Reputation System Audience: Speedrunner)
(Arcade Mode: Use the Info Broker, FIght powered up Enemies back to back, Select Race: Each has drawbacks and buffs,) 
- Route 2: Investigating Clues (Longer Game loop but hidden story layer revealed)

Premise 
Bounty Hunters find evil synths, cyborgs, symbiotes, and living beings. Player gets credits for completing tasks/bounties which contribute to general living (Upgrades/Better housing)

Rogue Products - Cyborgs, Synth (Detroit become human), Symbiotes

Rogues/Criminals: Normal people/Aliens

Player: They could choose their own race, Basically hunting down their own people. 

Story:
 Light Backstory of the CIty and the PC 
Who what when why when?
Focused on the city and the reasons why the bounty hunter is hunting these rogues and why they are here. 
Inner Story hidden under gameplay

requirements.title: Working project foundation
requirements.evidence: Working source and build (60); authored program logic (35); meaningful tests (20); run guide and evidence map (20); individual explanation (15).

requirements.title: Modular architecture
requirements.evidence: Show a module/class diagram, clear responsibilities and a change made without rewriting unrelated systems.

requirements.title: Three distinct levels or scenarios
requirements.evidence: Deliver three complete, meaningfully different scenarios using shared systems and test each.

requirements.title: Secure input and data handling
requirements.evidence: Document threats relevant to the project and test validation, safe error handling and protection of private data.

requirements.title: Database-backed workflow
requirements.evidence: Use a documented schema, parameterized operations, validation and recovery; demonstrate actual CRUD.

requirements.title: Reusable dialogue or interaction system
requirements.evidence: Use data-driven interactions in more than one situation; show how new content can be added.
